hypothesis: Explicit hand-object mechanics outperform generic holding
baseline_prompt: Create a realistic adult portrait in a refined interior. The subject stands in a dynamic elegant pose, wearing a satin outfit and holding a ceramic vase with both hands. Soft directional window light shapes the face. Foreground, midground, and background create depth. Hasselblad camera, 85mm lens, 8K masterpiece, ultra-detailed. Avoid bad anatomy, extra fingers, blur, artifacts, text, watermark, logo.

variants.old: holding a ceramic vase with both hands
variants.new: supporting a ceramic vase with the left palm beneath its base while the right hand steadies the neck, with the fingers conforming to the vase surface and the wrists aligned with the load

preserved_dimensions: identity unless factor explicitly tests it
